counter_plan.exit: 获得更高置信度的对手模式

rm_behavior_tree_across_hole.hold: 前哨受击或输出候选仍在攻击走廊
rm_behavior_tree_across_hole.implementation: 现有抢占链可扩展；需要对手画像参数

limitations: 普通受击事件不直接记录攻击者；17mm个体来源采用分级推断。
视频核验接口已保留，本轮未加入视频证据。
空间统计仅使用官方通信协议坐标和规则场地尺寸。
行为树内部地图、区域YAML和SCAU叠加图未用于赛事位置映射。

evidence.method: 规则同步扣血比例推断；数据库无原始牌色字段

defense_analysis.method: terminal base/outpost/mobile HP and clean damage exchange, blended with typical/downside aggregation

strength_analysis.opponent_adjustment: result_score is estimated jointly from every opponent and red/blue side; transparent opponent score is audit evidence and is not added twice

victory_rule_alignment.source: RMUC 2026比赛规则手册V2.0.1 第5.8节
priority: 前哨是否被毁及终局血量

strength_analysis.model: rule-aligned tactical composite; rolling-origin matchup calibration uses 10% regularized Bradley-Terry for East, a lower-spatial/higher-resource tactical profile for North, and fold-ECE uncertainty floors

spatial_analysis.method: team fact percentile with games/(games+6) shrinkage

firepower_analysis.method: team fact percentile with games/(games+6) shrinkage

objective_analysis.method: team fact percentile with games/(games+6) shrinkage

resource_analysis.method: team fact percentile with games/(games+6) shrinkage

adaptability_analysis.method: paired-condition transfer and residual response with component-specific evidence shrinkage

opponent_score_analysis.method: 75% direct-opponent adjusted win rate + 25% second-order opponent rate; unique opponents; Beta(1,1) prior. The display score is not added again because result_score already applies opponent correction through Bradley-Terry.
